rows.note: Use 遊行 as the all-purpose word for a public parade or procession, including one for a celebration or protest.

example.traditional: 今次遊行吸引咗好多市民參加。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 jau4 haang4 kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 si5 man4 caam1 gaa1

rows.note: Use 閱兵 for a formal display or inspection of military troops rather than a civilian procession.

example.english: A grand parade was held on National Day.
example.traditional: 國慶日舉行咗盛大閱兵。
example.jyutping: gwok3 hing3 jat6 geoi2 hang4 zo2 sing6 daai6 jyut6 bing1

rows.note: Use 排場 when parade means a showy or ostentatious display rather than a literal procession.

example.english: They put on quite a parade for the shop opening.
example.traditional: 佢哋為咗間舖頭開張，擺足排場。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 gaan1 pou3 tau2 hoi1 zoeng1 baai2 zuk1 paai4 coeng2
